brand_story.key_insight: The story connects a work intention to a visible shared ritual.
brand_story.headline: Focus begins when everyone can see it.
brand_story.body: Work sessions often start as private intentions. Fixture Focus gives that intention a visible beginning, active state, and end without adding another screen.
brand_story.product_connection: The illuminated plane and one tactile control turn the story into a concrete interaction.

product_introduction.key_insight: One signal architecture scales from personal to shared work.
product_introduction.headline: One calm signal, two working distances.
product_introduction.description: The family shares a rounded body, illuminated status plane, and one tactile control while changing scale for individual and room use.
product_introduction.shared_promise: Make focus visible without visual noise.
product_introduction.family_usp: One signal architecture for personal and shared work.

product_lineup_key_insight: Each product preserves the same promise while changing scale and viewing distance.
